candidate.explanation: v19 Final-Elevation candidate, cut 2026-08-16 on branch v19, built directly on the prior v18 candidate SHA 017ece2. v19 executes ONLY the genuine gaps in the Final Elevation pack (Scalvya side: 00, LB-01..LB-07, XAPP-01/02/03, FINAL-01); LB-03/04/06/07 and XAPP-01/02/03 were verified ALREADY SATISFIED and deliberately NOT re-done. The MW-* prompts target the separate primocera/Mellowa repository and are OUT OF SCOPE here. Changes landed as three focused commits: e253924 LB-02 (drafts scoped by the stable user UUID exposed by /api/auth/me instead of the mutable email / a workspace id used as identity; campaign draft restored only after identity resolves; sessionStorage handoffs governed by the storage-inventory contract); 35ebc5f LB-05 (readiness roll-up now degrades — never silently 'ok' — when a signal is unmeasured; reconcile:webhooks --apply bounded per run; docs/CAPACITY_MODEL_V19.md 10x model with UNAVAILABLE items and the measurement to close each); cce67aa LB-01 SAFE HARDENING ONLY (isStaleSubscriptionEvent fails closed on a non-PGRST116 read error; subscription analytics emit after the durable upsert; customer.created/updated drops a foreign-stamped customer). The LB-01 ownership-ARCHITECTURE/schema trio (remove the price-only legacy fallback, add a legacy-mapping table + customers.app_user_id migration, one typed ownership service) was DEFERRED by explicit owner decision (2026-08-16) as billing-architecture + production-data risk. Because v19 changed frontend source and the served bundle (now index-Cq2NTdSE) plus backend billing/ops logic, the affected checks were RE-RUN at this exact commit cce67aa on 2026-08-16: lint 0/0, 967 unit tests (+6 v19 regression suites: storage sessionStorage+UUID-scope, readiness fail-closed, reconciler batch bound, customer-gate x2), build, fresh bundle index-Cq2NTdSE, PUBLIC browser journeys 57 pass (incl. the axe scan 5/5, zero serious/critical), export 15/15, hero contrast 8/8, router reachability 15/15, npm audit 0, launch integrity. The AUTHENTICATED seeded matrix is NOT carried forward from v18 — v19 changed frontend source it exercises (generator.jsx/Campaigns.jsx) and it requires the owner's disposable non-production Supabase, which was not available in the execution environment; it is honestly recorded not_run at cce67aa and is the single blocking condition for public_paid until the owner re-runs `npm run test:e2e:auth` at this SHA. CARRY-FORWARD (valid by this manifest's own standard): `git diff 017ece2..cce67aa` over backend/migrations/ and over backend/lib/launch-config.js + backend/scripts/release-check.js is EMPTY — v19 added no migration and did not touch the config gate — so the applied 001-037 migration set and the production config-gate observation carry forward, with the standing owner action to re-confirm GET /api/admin/readiness against the deployed cce67aa before opening. Documentation-only commits after this SHA (including this launch-state record) do not invalidate the candidate; anything under backend/, app-src/, app/, e2e/, api/ or config does.

drift_from_baseline.subject: fix(billing): safe webhook ownership hardening (LB-01)
drift_from_baseline.closes_requirement: v19 LB-01 safe hardening only: isStaleSubscriptionEvent distinguishes no-row (PGRST116, proceed) from unavailable-read (throws → retry, never letting a possibly-older event overwrite newer data); subscription value/billing analytics emit AFTER the durable upsert so a failed+redelivered event can't double-count un-persisted state; customer.created/updated applies the same source policy as other events (a foreign-stamped customer is dropped). Tests: webhook-isolation 14/14 (+2 customer-gate). The ownership-architecture/schema trio was deferred by owner decision.

drift_from_baseline.subject: feat(ops): readiness fails closed on missing data; bounded reconciler batch; 10x capacity model (LB-05)
drift_from_baseline.closes_requirement: v19 LB-05: the readiness roll-up returns 'degraded' (never silently 'ok') when a signal is unmeasured — absence of data is never healthy; reconcile:webhooks --apply is bounded per run (--max/RECONCILE_MAX_BATCH, default 50) with the remainder deferred idempotently; docs/CAPACITY_MODEL_V19.md models a 10x cohort from the real configured caps and marks every unmeasured provider/infra number UNAVAILABLE with the exact measurement to close it. Tests: readiness-thresholds 6/6, webhook-reconcile 8/8.

drift_from_baseline.subject: fix(privacy): scope browser drafts by stable user UUID, not workspace/email (LB-02)
drift_from_baseline.closes_requirement: v19 LB-02: /api/auth/me exposes the stable Supabase user UUID from the validated session; studio and campaign recovery drafts scope by that UUID + the active workspace instead of the mutable email or a workspace id used AS an identity; the campaign draft is restored only after identity resolves; transient sessionStorage handoffs are governed by the storage-inventory contract (declared allowlist) plus a regression assertion that draft owners derive from account.id. Tests: storage-inventory 7/7.

drift_from_baseline.subject: test(e2e): run authenticated matrix single-worker for a deterministic gate (v18)
drift_from_baseline.closes_requirement: The authenticated RC runner (scripts/e2e-auth.mjs) now passes --workers=1. The three authenticated projects share one seeding webServer and each seeds/deletes its own auth user; under parallel workers a torn-down test's trailing request races another test's seed and the shared server cold-starts under load, producing non-deterministic timeouts (billing) and focus-timing failures (keyboard) that all pass in isolation. Single-worker makes the release gate deterministic; the public suite keeps workers:2. Evidence: 45/45 green at the candidate.

how_to_create_a_new_candidate: 1. Land all intended work on the release branch. No feature work after this point.
2. Set candidate.sha to the exact frozen commit and candidate.state to "frozen".

3. Re-run every required check at that SHA and record status, observed_at_sha and an evidence reference for each. A check whose underlying code changed since the last candidate may NOT be carried forward — re-run it or mark it not_run.
4. Attach owner evidence references for the live items.
5. Run `npm run launch:gate`. It recomputes both verdicts; it cannot be argued with.
6. Run `npm run launch:render` to regenerate docs/LAUNCH_STATE.md.

Any commit after step 2 that changes code creates a NEW candidate: the SHA no longer matches HEAD, every check pinned to the old SHA stops counting, and the verdict returns to NO-GO. Documentation-only commits (docs/ and the prompt packs) do not.
